overview_description.description:
Nanosferix is a product of Innovative Industrial Materials Factory LLC – a spinoff company from the KAUST Catalysis Center, supported by the Innovation Fund and Technology Office at the King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST).

They make hollow-silica fillers to allow ultralight engineering composite materials for high performance and advanced material applications. Nanosferix Hollow Silica is a unique and novel technology that works with commercial material systems to reduce the silica filler weight loading.
